hard_rules: Never claim AdSense approval before Google approves the site.
No ads on 404, error, navigation-only, technical, thin, under-construction or unreviewed legacy pages.
No copied/replicated articles without substantial original editorial value.
Advertising must not mimic navigation or obstruct publisher content.
Privacy disclosures must describe Google/third-party cookies and identifiers when Google ads are enabled.
EEA/UK/Switzerland personalized ads require a Google-certified CMP integrated with IAB TCF.
ads.txt and AdSense code must use the real publisher ID; never invent one.
